battle.name: 抗日戰爭
battle.theater: 北平盧溝橋及華北至華中戰線
battle.brief: 一九三七年七月七日盧溝橋事變引爆全面戰爭，至一九四五年九月二日《日本投降書》簽署，國民政府與日本帝國在華北、華中、華南對抗八年。卡面九五式輕戰車一九三五年量產配備，歸日軍戰車第一師團建制，自南京攻略戰起以每小時四十公里的速度插入步兵陣線側翼，在徐州會役與武漢會戰中反覆出現。

kit.name: 九五式輕戰車
kit.history: 1935年已列裝的日本輕戰車，抗日戰爭期間配屬在華地面部隊，用於步兵支援與短促機動。

countries: 抗日戰爭是中國與日本帝國在一九三七至一九四五年之間的一場全面戰爭，交戰體系分成正面會戰與敵後游擊兩條並行的戰線。中國方面由國民政府軍事委員會統一指揮，陸軍作戰部隊以德械師制裝備的中央軍居中，劃為平津、冀魯豫、太原、滬寧、徐州、武漢、豫湘桂等戰區，戰區之下設集團軍、軍、師、旅、團各級；海軍以江防艦隊與數量有限的巡洋艦、驅逐艦扼守長江水道與沿海要道，航空力量初期倚賴蘇聯與義大利志願航空隊，一九四一年之後由美軍第十四航空隊接續參戰。一九三七年九月，國民政府將紅軍改編為國民革命軍第八路軍，新四軍亦受命挺進華中，負責敵後游擊與根據地建設。日軍方面，東京大本營於一九三七年九月組建支那方面軍，同時成立上海派遣軍，其後再組建華中方面軍，兵力由關東軍、第五師團等精銳部隊與新編成的十餘個師團構成，配屬航空兵團與聯合艦隊；一九三八年以後，在中國關內的日軍以第十一軍、第十二軍、第十三軍等為骨幹，關東軍則以滿洲為基地策應。一九四〇年三月，汪精衛在南京成立傀儡政權，其轄下治安軍與協同等偽軍武裝在華中對抗日根據地作戰；蘇聯與英美則以貸款、租借法案與海上封鎖從外部牽制日本。
countriesEn: The Second Sino-Japanese War was a full-scale conflict between China and Imperial Japan fought from 1937 to 1945, and it ran along two parallel lines: set-piece battles on the front and guerrilla warfare behind the lines. On the Chinese side the National Government's Military Affairs Commission exercised overall command. The combat troops of the army, centred on the German-equipped divisions of the Central Army, were grouped into the Pingjin, Jilu-Yu, Taiyuan, Shanghai-Nanjing, Xuzhou, Wuhan and Henan-Hunan-Guangxi war zones, and each war zone was subdivided into army groups, armies, divisions, brigades and regiments. The navy relied on riverine flotillas and a limited number of cruisers and destroyers to hold the waterways of the Yangtze and the coastal lanes, while air power in the first years depended on Soviet and Italian volunteer aviation, with the United States Fourteenth Air Force taking over from 1941. In September 1937 the Red Army was reorganized into the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, and the New Fourth Army was ordered forward into central China to carry out guerrilla operations and construct base areas. On the Japanese side the Imperial General Headquarters formed the China Area Army in September 1937 and raised the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, later adding the Central China Expeditionary Army. Their strength came from the Kwantung Army, elite formations such as the 5th Division, and more than a dozen newly raised divisions, supported by air armies and the Combined Fleet. From 1938 the Japanese armies inside the Chinese frontier rested on the 11th, 12th and 13th Armies, while the Kwantung Army operated out of Manchuria. In March 1940 Wang Jingwei set up a puppet government at Nanjing, whose security forces and collaborationist units fought the anti-Japanese base areas in central China, while the Soviet Union, Britain and the United States applied pressure from outside through credits, the Lend-Lease Act and a maritime blockade.
people: 決策層面上，蔣中正以國民政府軍事委員會委員長身份在重慶主持全局，一九三七年九月二十二日發表《告日本國民書》，呼籲日本人民抵制軍國當局；蔣百里任軍令部部長，參謀總長徐永昌主持作戰計劃，李宗仁以第五戰區司令長官指揮徐州會役，張治中負責京滬會役，薛岳出任第九戰區司令長官並指揮長沙會戰，陳誠與白崇禧主持武漢會役的防禦。前線指揮官中，池峰城在臺兒莊以敢死隊夜襲日軍戰車與裝甲車，第29軍的吉星文與謝晉元死守宛平城及四行倉庫，張自忠殉國於襄樊一線。日軍方面由近衛內閣與大本營主導，東久邇宮稔彥王組閣，陸軍大臣杉山元主持軍令，支那方面軍先後由寺內正一與畑俊六出任司令官，上海派遣軍初由松井石根接掌，一九四〇年後改組為中國派遣軍，由岡村寧次任司令官。戰車第一師團以快速縱深突擊見長，成為日軍在華作戰的象徵。空中戰線上，蘇聯志願航空隊與美國飛虎隊隊長陳納德協同支援地面部隊；一九四二年史迪威出任中國戰區參謀長，與蔣中正在租借法案物資分配和反攻指揮權上屢有爭議，一九四四年調回美國，由魏德邁接任。共產黨方面，毛澤東主持中共中央，朱德任八路軍總指揮，彭德懷任副總指揮兼前線參謀長，一九四〇年主持百團大戰。
peopleEn: At the level of decision, Chiang Kai-shek presided over the war from Chongqing as chairman of the National Government's Military Affairs Commission and on 22 September 1937 published A Letter to the People of Japan, urging Japanese citizens to resist the military authorities. Chiang Baili headed the Military Affairs Ministry and General Chief of Staff Hsu Yung-chang directed operational planning. Li Zongren commanded the Xuzhou campaign as commander of the Fifth War Zone, Chang Chih-chung took charge of the Shanghai-Nanjing campaign, Hsueh Yueh became commander of the Ninth War Zone and ran the Changsha battles, and Ch'en Ch'eng and Pai Chung-hi handled the defensive phase of the Wuhan campaign. Among frontline commanders, Chi Feng-cheng led night attacks with daredevil units against Japanese tanks and armoured cars at Taierzhuang, while the 29th Army's Chi Hsing-wen and Hsieh Chin-yuan held Wanping and the Sihang Warehouse, and Chang Tzu-chung fell fighting near Xiangfan. On the Japanese side the Konoe cabinet and the General Headquarters directed everything: Prince Higashikuni Naruhiko formed the government, War Minister Sugiyama Genichi ran the army orders, and the China Area Army was led first by Terauchi Masayoshi and later by Hata Shunroku, while the Shanghai Expeditionary Army was initially under Matsui Iwane. In 1940 it was reorganized as the China Expeditionary Army with Okamura Yasuji as commander. The 1st Tank Division, famous for fast deep penetrations, became the symbol of Japanese campaigning in China. In the air, Soviet volunteer pilots and Claire Chennault of the American Flying Tigers supported the ground forces together. In 1942 Joseph Stilwell became chief of staff of the China theater and repeatedly collided with Chiang Kai-shek over the allocation of Lend-Lease supplies and over command of the counteroffensive; he was transferred back to the United States in 1944 and replaced by Albert Wedemeyer. On the Communist side Mao Zedong presided over the Central Committee, Zhu De commanded the Eighth Route Army, and Peng Dehuai served as deputy commander and front-line chief of staff, directing the Hundred Regiments Offensive of 1940.
kits: 卡面兵器九五式輕戰車是日本陸軍第一代由民間公司自力設計的量產戰車，一九三二年由三菱重工業開始設計，一九三四年完成試作車，一九三五年起量產，機密名稱以日文假名編號。車體全重約二點四噸，乘員三人，動力為三菱製造的空冷直列六缸柴油機，最大功率一百二十匹馬力，公路最高速度約每小時四十公里，履帶寬二百五十公厘，採前輪驅動與九四式裝甲車一系的蹺板式懸掛。武裝為九四式三十七公厘戰車砲，後期改用共用同一種彈藥匣的九八式三十七公厘砲，方向射界只能左右各十度，高低射界為仰角二十度、俯角十五度；砲塔是單人式，車長兼炮手以肩托操作，砲塔後部原裝兩挺六點五公厘輕機槍，後期換成七點七公厘機槍，車體前部另設一挺前方機槍與專任機槍手。三十七公厘炮初速低、榴彈有效殺傷半徑小，穿甲彈在三百五十公尺距離上仍能貫穿三十公厘裝甲，但面對四十五公厘正面裝甲的蘇制T-26與BT-7輕坦克已不足。九五式與九七式中戰車、九四式裝甲運兵車、九四式自動追擊砲車同族而生，一九三七年末起配屬戰車第一師團的兩個戰車聯隊，每個輕戰車大隊十二輛，步兵戰車連另編九輛乘員輸送型。中國軍隊同期使用的裝備包括蘇聯援助的T-26、BT-7輕坦克與美制M3 Stuart、M2A2輕坦克，國產中正式步槍、ZB26輕機槍、國造迫擊砲與擲彈筒；華北與華中作戰大量依靠馬車、人力車與挑夫運輸，後方以瀘州、昆明各兵工廠為骨幹晝夜生產步槍、機槍與彈藥。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Type 95 light tank, was the first mass-produced tank the Japanese Army designed from the ground up through a private company. Mitsubishi Heavy Industries began the design in 1932, completed the prototype in 1934 and put it into production from 1935; its classified name was given in Japanese katakana. The vehicle weighed about 2.4 tonnes, carried a crew of three, and used a Mitsubishi air-cooled inline six-cylinder diesel of 120 horsepower, giving a road speed of roughly 40 kilometres per hour with 250-millimetre tracks, front-wheel drive and a rocker-beam suspension inherited from the Type 94 armoured family. Its armament was the Type 94 37-millimetre tank gun, later replaced by the Type 98 37-millimetre gun which shared the same cartridge; traverse was limited to 10 degrees either side without moving the turret, and elevation ran from 20 degrees up to 15 degrees down. The turret was a one-man type in which the commander doubled as gunner and worked the gun against a shoulder pad; the turret rear carried two 6.5-millimetre light machine guns, later changed to 7.7-millimetre weapons, and a separate forward machine gun with a dedicated gunner was mounted in the hull front. The 37-millimetre gun had low muzzle velocity and a small lethal radius for its high-explosive shell, and although its armour-piercing round still defeated 30 millimetres of armour at 350 metres, it could no longer defeat the 45-millimetre frontal armour of Soviet T-26 and BT-7 light tanks. The Type 95 was developed alongside the Type 97 medium tank, the Type 94 armoured personnel carrier and the Type 94 self-propelled mortar, and from late 1937 it was issued to the two tank regiments of the 1st Tank Division, each light tank battalion holding twelve vehicles, with separate infantry tank companies of nine carrier-equipped vehicles. Equipment fielded by Chinese forces at the same time included Soviet T-26 and BT-7 light tanks and American M3 Stuart and M2A2 light tanks, the domestic Type 88 rifle, the ZB26 light machine gun, home-made mortars and grenade dischargers. In north and central China transport still relied heavily on carts, rickshaws and porters, and the arsenal back home worked day and night in factories at Luzhou and Kunming producing rifles, machine guns and ammunition.
tactics: 開戰初期，日軍的機械化部隊以戰車與九四式裝甲運兵車組成快速縱深突擊的先鋒，在平津、太原與京滬戰役中以每小時三十至四十公里的速度插入中方陣線的側翼與縱深，企圖以分割包圍取代正面消耗；中方則以步兵依托城垣與野戰陣地展開線式防禦，並在局部集中優勢兵力實施反擊，消耗日軍機動部隊。徐州會役中，第五戰區以側翼機動與三路圍攻的殲滅戰術應對日軍的快速縱深，一九三八年三月臺兒莊一役，中方步兵以夜襲方式逼近日軍戰車與裝甲車，用手榴彈與步槍近距離摧毀數十輛，迫使日軍戰車第一師團的攻勢中止，這是中方第一次以步兵近戰壓制日軍裝甲集群的戰例。一九三八年武漢會戰起，日軍在長江沿線與華北同時施壓，並以空軍支援地面突破；中方則在黃陂、縣河、萬家集一線節節抵抗，進行較大規模的戰役層級消耗。敵後戰線由八路軍、新四軍以游擊戰、破襲戰與交通線攻擊主導，專打日軍據點、公路與鐵路，迫使日軍以戰車配合裝甲車沿公路搜索追擊游擊隊，治安軍更以九五式輕戰車實施對根據地的掃蕩。一九四四年日軍為打通大陸交通線發動豫湘桂戰役，在突破作戰中大量使用裝甲車隊護衛撤回與補給車隊，並以據點守備與側翼掃蕩鞏固占領區，國軍則以反攻與游擊牽制其推進。
tacticsEn: In the opening months the Japanese mechanized forces formed a fast deep-penetration spearhead of tanks and Type 94 armoured personnel carriers. In the Pingjin, Taiyuan and Shanghai-Nanjing campaigns they drove into the flanks and depths of the Chinese lines at thirty to forty kilometres per hour, seeking to replace frontal attrition with encirclement and partition, while the Chinese side fought in linear defence from city walls and field fortifications and concentrated superior numbers for local counterattacks in order to wear down the Japanese mobile troops. In the Xuzhou campaign the Fifth War Zone answered Japanese deep penetration with flanking movement and a three-pronged annihilation, and at Taierzhuang in March 1938 Chinese infantry closed on Japanese tanks and armoured cars at night and destroyed several dozen of them with hand grenades and rifles at close quarters, halting the offensive of the 1st Tank Division; this was the first instance of Chinese infantry checking a Japanese armoured concentration in close combat. From the Wuhan campaign of 1938 the Japanese pressed simultaneously along the Yangtze and in north China, supporting their ground penetrations with the air force, while the Chinese held in a series of positions around Huangpi, Xianhe and Wanjiaji, absorbing the war at the scale of full campaigns. Behind the lines the Eighth Route Army and the New Fourth Army ran guerrilla war, sabotage and attacks on lines of communication, striking Japanese strongpoints, roads and railways and forcing the Japanese to hunt guerrilla bands with tanks and armoured cars along the highways, while the collaborationist security troops used Type 95 light tanks in sweeps against the base areas. In 1944 the Japanese launched the Henan-Hunan-Guangxi campaign to open a land route across the interior, using armoured columns in the breakthrough to escort withdrawing and supply convoys and consolidating occupied ground with strongpoints and flanking sweeps, while the Nationalist armies harassed the advance with counterattacks and guerrilla activity.
data: 九五式輕戰車總產量約二千三百八十輛，是日本歷年產量最多的戰車型號，其中關內派遣軍與關東軍的具體存廢數字各方記載不一，戰後日本本土尚存約四百四十輛，南方軍殘存約一百三十輛。性能方面，該車全重約二點四噸，乘員三人，一百二十匹馬力，公路最高速度約每小時四十公里，裝甲厚八至二十公厘，主砲口徑三十七公厘。戰役層面，全面抗戰爆發時國民革命軍總兵力約二百萬，陸軍常備師約一百八十個；國方統計正面會戰二十二次、戰役一千一百一十七次、戰鬥三萬餘次，各方統計口徑不一，學界一般認為中國軍隊作戰部隊累積傷亡逾三百萬人。一九三八年前後日軍在關內的兵力達到高峰，總數以數十萬計，關東軍與滿洲國軍另計。戰車第一師團編有戰車兩部與步兵三部，總兵力約一萬，戰車總數二百餘輛，其中輕戰車大隊每隊十二輛。一九三七年十一月南京攻略戰，日軍戰車部隊首次在華大規模投入。時間上，一九三七年七月七日全面開戰，一九四五年八月十五日日本宣布接受《波茨坦宣言》，九月二日《日本投降書》在美軍戰艦密蘇里號上簽署，九月九日南京舉行受降典禮，同年十月臺灣光復。戰爭期間後方軍火產量急增，僅步槍與機槍彈藥一項即以百萬發計，具體數字各方統計互有出入，引用時須存疑。
dataEn: Total production of the Type 95 light tank was about 2,380 vehicles, making it the most numerous Japanese tank type ever built; the exact numbers remaining with the China Area Army and the Kwantung Army are recorded inconsistently, and after the war some 440 vehicles were still in Japan proper with roughly 130 more in the Southern Army. In performance the vehicle weighed about 2.4 tonnes with a crew of three, produced 120 horsepower, ran at about 40 kilometres per hour on roads, carried eight to twenty millimetres of armour and fired a 37-millimetre gun. At the campaign level, the National Revolutionary Army numbered about two million men when full-scale war began, with roughly 180 regular divisions in the army. Official Chinese statistics count 22 set-piece campaigns, 1,117 engagements and more than 30,000 battles, though the counting conventions differ between sources; scholarship generally puts the accumulated casualties of Chinese combat troops above three million. Around 1938 the Japanese strength inside the frontier peaked at several hundred thousand men, with the Kwantung Army and the Manchukuo armies counted separately. The 1st Tank Division contained two tank regiments and three infantry regiments, about 10,000 men in all, with more than 200 tanks, of which each light tank battalion held twelve. At the assault on Nanjing in November 1937 Japanese tank formations were committed in China on a large scale for the first time. On the timetable: full-scale war opened on 7 July 1937; on 15 August 1945 Japan announced its acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration; the Instrument of Surrender of Japan was signed aboard the American battleship Missouri on 2 September; the surrender ceremony was held at Nanjing on 9 September; and Taiwan was recovered in October of the same year. Munitions output in the rear areas expanded sharply during the war, with rifle and machine-gun ammunition alone running into the millions of rounds, though exact figures vary between sources and should be treated with caution.
cause: 抗日戰爭的起因是日本二十年代以來的大陸政策與中國政局的變化互相撞擊。一九三一年九一八事變之後，日本取得關東州並扶植滿洲國；到一九三五年，日本在華北推動自治運動，冀東防共自治政府成立，華北的駐軍與鐵路權益不斷擴張，中國國民政府則在北方喪失主權。中國內部的變化同樣關鍵：一九三五年瓦窯堡會議確定了抗日民族統一戰線的政策，一九三六年西安事變經和平解決，第二次國共合作由此形成，內戰停止，抗日準備得以在統一旗號下推進。日軍並未因西安事變收手，反而加快在華北集結兵力的步伐；一九三七年七月初，日軍在盧溝橋一帶進行夜間演習，藉口士兵失蹤要求進入宛平城搜查，遭中國守軍拒絕後炮擊城垣，事變遂擴大。日軍同時在平津地區增兵，華北方面軍於七月二十九日攻佔北平與天津；八月十三日戰火又在上海引燃，中方守軍在吳淞與寶山一線抵抗，八月十四日蔣中正發表抗戰聲明，戰爭正式全面化。外在條件亦不容忽視：德國與義大利在遠東站在日本一邊，蘇聯在一九三六年訂立互不侵犯條約並向中國提供貸款與軍事顧問，這些都影響了各方的估計與抉擇。
causeEn: The origins of the war lie in the collision between Japanese continental policy from the 1920s and the changing political situation inside China. After the September 18 Incident of 1931 Japan took control of Kwantung and propped up the state of Manchukuo; by 1935 it was pushing autonomy in north China, the East Hebei Autonomous Government had been set up, and Japanese troops and railway rights kept expanding while the National Government was losing sovereignty in the north. Change inside China mattered just as much. The 1935 Wayaobao Conference set the policy of an anti-Japanese national united front, and the peaceful settlement of the Xi'an Incident in 1936 brought about the second united front between the Kuomintang and the Communists, ended the civil war and allowed anti-Japanese preparation to proceed under a single banner. The Japanese did not stand down after Xi'an; they speeded up the concentration of troops in north China. In early July 1937 the Japanese held night exercises around Marco Polo Bridge and, claiming a soldier had gone missing, demanded entry into Wanping city to search; when Chinese defenders refused they shelled the wall and the incident widened. Japanese forces were reinforced in the Pingjin area at the same time, and on 29 July the North China Area Army seized Beiping and Tianjin. On 13 August war flared again at Shanghai, where Chinese troops held at Wusong and Baoshan, and on 14 August Chiang Kai-shek issued his war declaration, making the conflict total. External conditions cannot be ignored either: Germany and Italy stood on Japan's side in the Far East, while the Soviet Union signed a non-aggression treaty in 1936 and extended credits and military advisers to China, all of which shaped the estimates and the choices of every side.
impact: 八年戰爭把中國從一個軍閥割據、工業落後的半殖民地國家，改造成能以國家體制長期消耗的戰爭機器。政治上，抗日民族統一戰線在實踐中確立了國共合作抗日的局面，國民政府遷都重慶後依靠全國性的徵兵、稅收與統制政策維持作戰，軍隊數量與裝備體系在戰爭中大幅擴張；同一場戰爭也讓中共軍隊脫離正規軍序列、走向獨立自主的發展道路，一九四〇年百團大戰之後，八路軍與新四軍在華北、華中根據地的影響力急升，戰後的力量對比被顛覆。經濟與工業方面，沿海工廠與學校大規模內遷至西南與西北，兵工產能與民用生產在後方集中，重慶、成都、昆明、瀘州、桂林等地成為新的工業中心；滇緬公路被打斷之後，一九四二年至四五年靠駝峰航線維持對華空運，規模遠不足以支撐龐大的消耗。國際上，中國戰場是世界反法西斯同盟的重要支柱，蘇聯志願航空隊、美軍飛虎隊與租借法案把中國納入同盟國體系，中國成為聯合國安理會常任理事國與四大國之一。裝備層面，正是這場戰爭讓中方第一次建立成規模的裝甲與機械化部隊，國軍戰車部隊在接收美式裝甲車後逐步成軍，而中共建軍之初的第一支裝甲部隊所用車輛即是繳獲的九五式輕戰車。城市、工廠與鐵路公路系統在反覆淪陷與收復中被破壞又修復，這是這場戰爭留下的最長久的物質痕跡。
impactEn: Eight years of war turned China from a semi-colonial country divided by warlords and short of industry into a state capable of sustaining a long war effort through national institutions. Politically the anti-Japanese national united front established, in practice, a working arrangement between the Kuomintang and the Communists. After moving the seat of government to Chongqing, the National Government sustained the war through nationwide conscription, taxation and control policies, and the size of the army and the scale of its equipment system expanded dramatically during the conflict. At the same time the war allowed the Communist army to leave the regular order of battle and develop along independent lines; after the Hundred Regiments Offensive of 1940 the Eighth Route Army and the New Fourth Army gained rapid influence in the base areas of north and central China, and the balance of forces after the war was reversed. Economically and industrially the coastal factories and schools moved inland on a massive scale to the southwest and northwest, munitions and civilian production concentrated in the rear, and Chongqing, Chengdu, Kunming, Luzhou and Guilin became new industrial centres. Once the Burma Road was cut, supply to China from 1942 to 1945 depended on the Hump air route, whose capacity was far too small for a war of this size. Internationally the Chinese battlefield was a main pillar of the world anti-fascist alliance: the Soviet volunteer air force, the American Flying Tigers and the Lend-Lease Act drew China into the Allied camp, and China emerged as a permanent member of the Security Council and one of the four great powers. In terms of equipment this war gave China its first large-scale armoured and mechanized formations; the Nationalist tank arm grew into shape as American armoured vehicles arrived, and the first tank unit ever formed by the Chinese Communists was equipped with captured Type 95 light tanks. Cities, factories, railways and roads were destroyed and rebuilt through repeated loss and recapture, and that is the longest-lasting material trace the war left behind.
result: 一九四五年八月十五日，日本天皇以廣播宣布接受《波茨坦宣言》，無條件投降；九月二日《日本投降書》在東京灣美軍戰艦密蘇里號上簽署，岡村寧次在南京向中國戰區受降代表交出中國大陸日軍的指揮權，九月九日受降典禮在南京舉行，同年十月臺灣光復，東北則由蘇聯遠東軍攻入，關東軍覆沒。這場戰爭的結果是中國取得抗日戰爭的勝利，但代價極為巨大：中國軍隊作戰部隊傷亡以百萬計，城市、工業與交通系統受破壞的程度在近代中國史上空前；國際上，德國、義大利與日本三個軸心國的失敗已無可挽回，戰後秩序由美蘇主導，中國以戰時大國身份進入聯合國並取得安理會常任理事國席位，但在亞洲的影響力被日本取代。裝備的結局同樣清楚：九五式輕戰車的實物在戰後大量被繳獲、拆解與改裝，數百輛分別被國民革命軍與中共軍隊用於國共內戰，蘇聯遠東方面軍在滿洲作戰中亦接收並使用過日式九五式，另有部分車體在戰後被改作牽引車、搶修車與工程車，於一九四〇至五〇年代的重建中延續了使用壽命。戰爭結束的同時，國內政治的裂痕並未癒合，一九四六年全面內戰爆發，戰時建立的統一戰線瓦解，這一結果最終改變了中國的政權歸屬。
resultEn: On 15 August 1945 the Japanese emperor announced by broadcast that Japan accepted the Potsdam Declaration and would surrender unconditionally. On 2 September the Instrument of Surrender of Japan was signed aboard the American battleship Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and Okamura Yasuji handed over command of the Japanese armies on the Chinese mainland to the Chinese reception representative at Nanjing; the surrender ceremony was held at Nanjing on 9 September, Taiwan was recovered that October, and in the northeast the Soviet Far Eastern Army drove in and the Kwantung Army was destroyed. The outcome of the war was a Chinese victory in the war of resistance, but at enormous cost: Chinese combat troops suffered casualties in the millions, and the destruction of cities, industry and transport was without precedent in modern Chinese history. Internationally the defeat of the three axis powers, Germany, Italy and Japan, was settled, the postwar order was dominated by the United States and the Soviet Union, and China entered the United Nations as a great power with a permanent seat on the Security Council, though its influence in Asia was displaced by Japan. The fate of the equipment is equally clear: large numbers of Type 95 light tanks were captured, stripped and modified after the war, several hundred serving the Nationalist and Communist armies alike in the resumed civil war, and the Soviet Far Eastern Army received and employed Japanese Type 95s in the fighting in Manchuria; other hulls were converted into towing, recovery and engineering vehicles that kept running through the reconstruction of the late 1940s and 1950s. Alongside the end of the war the political fractures inside the country did not heal: full-scale civil war broke out in 1946, the united front built up during the war fell apart, and that outcome eventually changed which regime ruled China.
